title: Liv Rosenthal’s Website
text: Hello! I am Olivia (Liv) Rosenthal and I am taking Foundations of Data Science at Pomona College. I love going on runs, crafting, summer camp and the beach. I want to be a teacher for either elementary or middle school. I love math and find it incredibly challenging. A fun fact about me is that I played a tap dancing rat in Shrek the Musical in 6th grade. I don’t like cilantro, the act of being non-chalant and party poopers.

title: Tidy Tuesday 1
text:
pixar_data <- pixar_films |>
  left_join(public_response, by = "film")


ggplot(pixar_data, aes(x = release_date, y = run_time))+
  geom_point(color= "navy")+
  labs(x = "Release Date", y="Run Time min", title = "Pixar Films Release Date and Run Times")
